date_note: Telesíntese article of 25 November reports the announcement made that day at the Brasil Ciberseguro event; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Brazil's GSI minister announced that a draft national cybersecurity law, which would create a national authority, goes to a Creden meeting on 2 December, Telesíntese reports.
geo_basis: Event held in Brasília, per Telesíntese; GSI is a federal agency
plain: Brazil's security office minister said a draft national cybersecurity law will be reviewed at a government council meeting on 2 December, according to Telesíntese.
summary: According to Telesíntese, GSI Minister Marcos Antônio Amaro dos Santos announced on Wednesday 25 November, at the opening of the Brasil Ciberseguro event in Brasília, that the draft General Law on National Cybersecurity will be reviewed on 2 December at an extraordinary meeting of the Creden. The draft, prepared by the CNCiber, includes creating a national authority to regulate, coordinate, control and oversee the sector.
title: Brazil's GSI minister says draft national cybersecurity law goes to Creden meeting on 2 December, Telesíntese reports

validation.note: Only Telesíntese was read; the minister's statement is quoted by it. The GSI's own page was not read.

review.note: minister, 2 December Creden meeting, CNCiber draft, national authority and 25 November date checked against Telesintese
